feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Man charged with raping woman on Brighton beach
articles.summary: A 28-year-old man has been charged with raping a woman on Brighton beach in the summer.

articles.title: Man dies after being found seriously injured in hospital car park
articles.summary: A man in his 20s has been arrested after a 21-year-old man was found seriously injured in a hospital car park, more than 16 miles from where he was wounded.

articles.title: Britain's next fighter jet could be last with a pilot in the cockpit, says RAF chief
articles.summary: Britain's next fighter jet could be the last to fly with a pilot in the cockpit, according to the head of the RAF.

articles.title: Hotel Chocolat recalls several Christmas boxes over potential salmonella risk
articles.summary: Several different sizes of Christmas boxes by Hotel Chocolat have been recalled due to a potential risk of salmonella in pistachios.

articles.title: Man charged with attempted murder after councillor stabbed in Bradford
articles.summary: A man has been charged with attempted murder after a councillor was stabbed while out door-knocking in Bradford.

articles.title: German bidder stages last-gasp bid to rescue Poundland
articles.summary: A German investment firm has made a last-minute entry into the race to save Poundland, just days before its directors face the bleak prospect of appointing administrators to one of Britain's biggest high street retailers.

articles.title: Harry Kane shares image from hospital bed after injury
articles.summary: England captain Harry Kane has vowed to be back for the "business end of the season" after undergoing surgery on a torn ligament in his left ankle.

articles.title: Cold weather alert extended as temperatures drop to -10C
articles.summary: A cold weather warning has been extended as temperatures dropped to -10C (14F) overnight into Saturday.
